title: Scalability sweeps
summary: User ramp 1->200, agent-count sweep 10->1,000, mixed read/write ratios, sustained high-write and high-read, a 60-minute soak, and a long-session sweep 10->10,000 turns.
description:
Run the full scalability matrix from BENCHMARK_STRATEGY.md Phase 5.3: user ramp 1->10->50->200 concurrent users looking for the P95-latency inflection point; agent-count sweep 10->100->1,000 distinct `agent_id`s tracking throughput and leak count; mixed read/write workloads at 70/30, 50/50, and 30/70, explicitly checking for writer starvation under read-heavy mixes; sustained 100%-write and 100%-read runs to find max sustained ops/s in each direction; a 60-minute soak using BM-6's RSS sampler to catch memory growth or error-rate drift over time; and a long-session sweep of 10/100/1,000/10,000 turns per thread measuring `get_context_card()`/`get_summary()` latency growth.

Acceptance: P95 inflection point identified per dimension; sustained max write/s and read QPS recorded as concrete numbers; the soak run shows no RSS growth trend and no error-rate drift; writer starvation under read-heavy mixes is explicitly checked and reported either way, not just assumed absent. Depends on BM-12.
